description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_용수관련정보 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 생활용수: 총 인구, 급수인구, 총 급수량, LPCD, 생산량, 업종별 부과량, 지방상수도 자급률 등 공업용수: 하천수 이용량, 지하수 이용량, 해수 이용량, 산단 이용량 등 농업용수. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 생활용수, 농업용수, 공업용수, 이용량, 회귀수량. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
